mapper.select: SELECT lp.tenant_id AS tenantId, lp.config_json AS configJson FROM login_page lp INNER JOIN tenant t ON lp.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.sub_domain = #{subDomain}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_page ( tenant_id, config_json, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{configJson}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_json = #{configJson}, updated_at = NOW()
